description: Upload a local video (.mp4/.mov) or image (.jpg/.png), up to 1 GB (files over 32 MB go in chunks), to the ad account. It is not attached to any ad. Then poll snap_get_media until READY and use snap_create_creative. Previews (file check only) unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name.description: Name to give the new item. Shown in Ads Manager.

name: snap_upload_media
